headline: OpenAI unveils groundbreaking updates to Codex and launches GPT-Rosalind for life sciences.

items.title: Codex for (almost) everything
items.summary: The updated Codex app for macOS and Windows incorporates features such as computer use, in-app browsing, image generation, memory, and plugins to streamline developer workflows. This advancement aims to enhance productivity and efficiency by integrating these capabilities directly into the development environment, providing a seamless experience for users.
items.why_it_matters: These updates significantly enhance the capabilities of Codex, making it a more versatile tool for developers working with AI applications.

items.title: Introducing GPT-Rosalind for life sciences research
items.summary: OpenAI has introduced GPT-Rosalind, a state-of-the-art model designed to accelerate processes in drug discovery, genomics analysis, protein reasoning, and scientific research workflows. This model leverages advanced reasoning capabilities specifically tailored for the life sciences sector, promising to expedite research and development in these critical areas.
items.why_it_matters: GPT-Rosalind opens new possibilities for AI-driven solutions in life sciences, offering tech leads a powerful tool to innovate in health and biology fields.

items.title: Accelerating the cyber defense ecosystem that protects us all
items.summary: OpenAI collaborates with leading security firms and enterprises through the Trusted Access for Cyber initiative, deploying GPT-5.4-Cyber and offering $10M in API grants. This effort aims to enhance global cyber defense capabilities, integrating AI-driven insights to proactively counter cyber threats.
items.why_it_matters: Strengthening cybersecurity with AI integrations offers critical protection for tech infrastructure, making it essential for developers building secure systems.

items.title: The next evolution of the Agents SDK
items.summary: OpenAI has updated the Agents SDK, introducing native sandbox execution and a model-native harness. These enhancements facilitate the development of secure, long-running agents capable of operating across various files and tools, thereby improving flexibility and security in agent deployment.

items.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS
items.summary: Google introduces Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS, an advanced text-to-speech model featuring granular audio tags for precise control over expressive audio generation. This innovation allows developers to create more natural and expressive AI-driven speech applications, enhancing user interaction quality.

items.title: Simulating Human Cognition: Heartbeat-Driven Autonomous Thinking Activity Scheduling for LLM-based AI systems
items.summary: This research explores the potential for large language models (LLMs) to adopt more flexible and efficient control flows through heartbeat-driven autonomous scheduling. The study highlights limitations in current reactive frameworks and suggests improvements for adaptability in AI systems.
